questions.name: Monitoring, Logging, Analysis, Remediation, and Performance Optimization
questions.text: A CloudOps engineer must collect application latency metrics from an EC2-hosted service and retain API activity history for incident investigations. Which combination should the engineer configure?

answers.text: Amazon CloudWatch metrics for latency and AWS CloudTrail trails for API activity
AWS Config rules for latency and Amazon S3 access logs for API activity
Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus for API audit history and AWS CloudTrail Lake for latency metrics
AWS Systems Manager Inventory for latency and Amazon EventBridge archives for API activity

explanations.a: CloudWatch and CloudTrail configuration is best addressed by Amazon CloudWatch metrics for latency and AWS CloudTrail trails for API activity, because it matches the operational requirement in the scenario. This is the correct answer.
explanations.b: CloudWatch and CloudTrail configuration is not satisfied by AWS Config rules for latency and Amazon S3 access logs for API activity. CloudWatch and CloudTrail configuration requires a telemetry service for metrics and an audit service for API calls; these services do not provide that complete pairing.
explanations.c: CloudWatch and CloudTrail configuration is not satisfied by Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus for API audit history and AWS CloudTrail Lake for latency metrics. CloudWatch and CloudTrail configuration separates metric collection from API auditing; Prometheus does not create AWS API audit history and CloudTrail Lake is not a latency metric source.
explanations.d: CloudWatch and CloudTrail configuration is not satisfied by AWS Systems Manager Inventory for latency and Amazon EventBridge archives for API activity. CloudWatch and CloudTrail configuration needs runtime metrics and API event history; Systems Manager Inventory records instance metadata and EventBridge archives are not a substitute for CloudTrail audit records.

explanations.b: CloudWatch and CloudTrail configuration is best addressed by Amazon CloudWatch Container Insights and Amazon Managed Service for Prometheus, because it matches the operational requirement in the scenario. This is the correct answer.
explanations.c: CloudWatch and CloudTrail configuration is not satisfied by AWS Config aggregators and AWS Trusted Advisor. CloudWatch and CloudTrail configuration for container telemetry requires metric collection; Config aggregators and Trusted Advisor provide compliance and recommendation views rather than workload metrics.
explanations.d: CloudWatch and CloudTrail configuration is not satisfied by Amazon Athena and AWS Cost Explorer. CloudWatch and CloudTrail configuration for container telemetry is not provided by query and cost tools; Athena can analyze stored logs but does not collect the metrics itself.

questions.text: An operations team wants to detect unauthorized changes to security groups and also monitor CPUUtilization for EC2 instances. Which approach meets both needs?

Use Amazon Inspector for security group API events and AWS Backup for CPUUtilization

explanations.b: CloudWatch and CloudTrail configuration is not satisfied by Use AWS X-Ray for security group API events and AWS Config only for CPUUtilization. CloudWatch and CloudTrail configuration does not rely on X-Ray for AWS API auditing, and AWS Config records resource configuration rather than standard EC2 CPU metrics.
explanations.c: CloudWatch and CloudTrail configuration is best addressed by Use AWS CloudTrail for security group API events and Amazon CloudWatch metrics for CPUUtilization, because it matches the operational requirement in the scenario. This is the correct answer.
explanations.d: CloudWatch and CloudTrail configuration is not satisfied by Use Amazon VPC Flow Logs for security group API events and Amazon CloudFront logs for CPUUtilization. Create a CloudWatch alarm for IAM changes without retaining logs
Enable VPC Flow Logs for every subnet

explanations.d: CloudWatch and CloudTrail configuration is not satisfied by CreateSnapshot to capture the metrics from the EBS volume. CloudWatch and CloudTrail configuration is not achieved through EBS snapshots; snapshots capture block storage state.

questions.text: A CloudWatch alarm is in INSUFFICIENT_DATA after creation for a custom metric. What is the most likely cause?

The VPC has no NAT gateway
The SNS topic has encryption enabled

explanations.c: CloudWatch alarms is best addressed by The custom metric has not published enough datapoints for the alarm period, because it matches the operational requirement in the scenario. This is the correct answer.
explanations.d: CloudWatch alarms is not satisfied by The EC2 instance has a public IP address. CloudWatch alarms evaluate metric data; a public IP address does not determine metric availability.
